scope: Ten read-only route and Nodes table canonical cases. Reuse existing dedicated browser session and loopback forward; retain the two exact batch05-owned Scripts. No new fixture, deletion, Task, Run, User, Group, Node, or Agent writes; no source/global inventory edits.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, then browser back/forward from a known owned Script detail and return to dashboard.
cases.oracles: GET /api/me and actual dashboard data GET method/path/status/count; main ready/loading/error classification and metrics/cards visible agree with returned data. No refresh internals or forced query calls.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, use actual visible row detail link if present, then back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/agents status/count and any actual associated safe GETs; table/empty/error state, visible rows and detail hrefs match real dataset. IDs may be retained in evidence only if needed for route binding.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, use an actual row detail link, back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/nodes status/count; ready/table state, rows, fields and href behavior; safe identity match booleans against preflight snapshot. No node writes.

cases.actions: Open only the real agent href discovered from current agents/nodes UI, refresh, back/forward.
cases.oracles: Actual detail GET(s), returned status/identity match boolean, detail readiness/error state and actual UI values consistent; no guessed or fabricated IDs.

cases.actions: Open only an actual node link from the current table, refresh, back/forward.
cases.oracles: Actual detail GET(s), identity match boolean, detail readiness/error state and link/route consistency; no edits or status actions.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, then back/forward. Do not submit or create a Task.
cases.oracles: Actual GETs and zero POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE; new-task title, defaults, required field and form ready/error classification.

cases.actions: Search using a safe term derived from an actual visible row, search a guaranteed non-match, then click actual Reset/clear.
cases.oracles: GET /api/nodes count unchanged; visible-hit count, no-results UI and Reset restoration; zero writes; avoid persisting raw full row.

cases.actions: Click actual Hostname/Name header through fresh refs to exercise asc/desc/clear where supported.
cases.oracles: Capture only row identity tokens in a stable nonsecret form and visible order for each state; GET remains unchanged; zero writes. Mark unsupported cycle PARTIAL.

cases.actions: Hide one safe visible column, refresh and confirm persistence, restore it and refresh.
cases.oracles: Menu checkbox, header/cells absent/present, rows stable; only read/write the current browser local preference, no server mutation. Restore original preference in finally.

cases.actions: Choose actual page size 20 and refresh; exercise next/prev only if live total is greater than the current page size without adding fixtures.
cases.oracles: GET /api/nodes count, selected page size persistence, row count and enabled/disabled page buttons; page transition remains PARTIAL if actual dataset does not span pages.

safety_and_evidence.network: Filter locally to same-origin method/path/status/count only; never save raw request/response, headers, tokens, page bodies, or unrelated row values.
safety_and_evidence.mutations: Route browsing and local table preferences only. Restore the original table preference in finally. Stop if any unexpected write request or owned resource status changes.
safety_and_evidence.validation: Each case records actual user action, request oracle, resulting business data/state, and visible UI feedback. Loading/error/empty are classified from live DOM and actual requests. Page 2 is never inferred from a page-size control.
